name: AdvancedSearchSrRowParserV1
preconditions: candidate passed shared path/reparse/stability/XLSX security boundary
required SRNo semantic header resolves exactly once
all security/resource limits remain in force through complete EOF
row_identity: resolve SRNo by semantic header, trim only accepted spreadsheet whitespace, then require exactly eight ASCII digits
valid identity becomes entity_kind=service_request and canonical_primary_id is the exact eight digits
missing, blank, malformed, prefixed/suffixed or longer digit sequence becomes invalid_row with SR_ID_INVALID and fabricates no Service Request
similar summary/customer/contact/device evidence can never adopt or identify an SR

text_input: after surrounding spreadsheet-whitespace trimming require exact ASCII YYYY-MM-DD[T|space]HH:MM:SS with optional . plus 1..6 fractional ASCII digits and optional uppercase Z or signed +/-HH:MM offset
validate the Gregorian calendar/time and explicit offset; lowercase z, timezone abbreviations, locale/slash dates, omitted seconds and offset forms without a colon are malformed
if explicit offset exists use it exactly; otherwise attach America/Guayaquil
normalize the resolved instant to UTC, then discard fractional remainder without rounding/carry and persist nonnegative whole Unix seconds
a resolved instant before Unix epoch is malformed because persisted instant authority is int64>=0
xlsx_numeric_input: accept only a registered temporal cell whose openpyxl semantic value, under the workbook's supported 1900/1904 epoch and date/time style, is a Python datetime/date value
a datetime carrying an explicit tzinfo uses it; a naive datetime/date uses America/Guayaquil; date-only semantic values use local 00:00:00
normalize to UTC whole seconds under the same fractional-discard rule
a bare int/float numeric value not resolved by openpyxl as date/time is malformed temporal evidence; formulas/cached formula results never qualify
prohibitions: no Report Date substitution for Last Update
no filename chronology substitution for row chronology

duration_parser.blank: when the semantic header is present, blank is usable integer_value=0 duration_seconds; absent header remains missing coverage and creates no zero field
duration_parser.text_input: after surrounding spreadsheet-whitespace trimming require the ADVANCED_SEARCH_SR_V1 decimal-days grammar; parse with Decimal directly from that ASCII text
duration_parser.xlsx_numeric_input: accept finite nonnegative int/float but not bool/date/time; obtain locale-independent decimal input as str(cell.value) and construct Decimal from that text so Python 3.13/3.14 and Windows/Linux produce the same semantic decimal
duration_parser.conversion: seconds_decimal = source_days * Decimal(86400); quantize to Decimal(1) with ROUND_HALF_EVEN; convert to integer and require 0 <= integer <= 9223372036854775807
duration_parser.malformed: negative, nonfinite, out-of-range, exponent/locale/unit-bearing text or unsupported semantic cell types produce value_state=malformed with bounded source evidence; never clamp, infer or preserve them as usable zero
duration_parser.logical_value: usable nonblank/blank values fingerprint and stage only the resulting whole integer duration_seconds as integer_value; source decimal representation is provenance rather than an alternate authority

active_field_parsing.blank: blank evidence; preserve accepted source projection
usable explicit source-display clear candidate at acceptance; staged source value_state remains blank and does not mutate Contact by itself
duration_parser usable exact zero source report; regression against prior nonzero is review-required

deferred_instant_rule: resolve_by and resolve_by_suspend use instant_parser but remain provenance-only and cannot drive Beta 1.0 workflow/SLA authority
row_chronology: only usable Last Update integer UTC seconds becomes source_row_chronology_utc. Missing/blank/malformed Last Update remains NULL; filename chronology, filesystem mtime, import time and Report Date never substitute for row chronology. A changed field without chronology comparable to prior accepted field evidence becomes review-required rather than assumed newer.
duplicate_partition: recompute the exact shared ROW_V1 hash from every parsed row before grouping
group valid rows by canonical eight-digit SR identity after parsing

exact equivalent allowlisted logical rows collapse to one effective logical observation variant with deterministic duplicate_count and SOURCE_EQUIVALENT_DUPLICATE classification finding while every physical row remains staged as bounded provenance
different meaningful allowlisted logical content for the same SR identity is conflicting source evidence; retain observations/findings and block only that SR proposal scope until reviewed
conflict for one SR never rejects unrelated valid SR identities
invalid rows have no canonical SR identity and may collapse only by equal ROW_V1 hash; they never create an SR identity conflict group
proposal_seeds: missing exact official SR -> sr_create_or_adopt seed
existing exact official SR -> in-place source adoption/projection seed preserving service_request_id and all SOMA-owned history
field-level recognized source delta -> sr_source_projection seed
Customer Account Code/Customer Org. label -> reviewed Customer Organization reconciliation candidate seed
Customer Contact label -> reviewed Contact reconciliation candidate seed
Current Handler -> separate reviewed Contact reconciliation candidate seed while source assignment remains text authority
recognized terminal-to-nonterminal reversal -> high-risk sr_terminal_reversal_review seed
new blank/zero Suspension Duration contradicting prior accepted nonzero -> high-risk sr_suspension_regression_review seed
population_postpass: after complete conflict classification, compute valid canonical SR identity set for the candidate population
compare only against the latest previously accepted Advanced Search population under exact source-family/checkpoint lineage
a previously observed SR omitted from the new population seeds a high-risk source-disappearance review/warning; omission never deletes, archives, finalizes or mutates the SR
later valid reappearance resolves to the same surviving SR and may clear current disappearance warning through governed acceptance
prohibitions: no overwrite of SOMA-owned relationships, Working Notes, Tasks, Objectives, Inventory, Infrastructure, review or audit history
no source status to Task/Objective execution mutation
no alternate timestamp/duration grammar outside ADVANCED_SEARCH_SR_V1
